verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say it installs as an app on GitHub and automatically reviews new pull requests. It comments on bugs and improvements, and its review-comment threads can be replied to, reacted to, and auto-resolved, which implies native PR review comments. Only GitHub is documented, and "in minutes" refers to setup time rather than to how fast a review is posted. Missing for 10: GitLab support evidence, documented standard-review turnaround time, explicit confirmation of line-level inline placement, independent hands-on corroboration.
